about: The ODM XML reader's refusals of text files (ODM-1, P-ODMIN-1), read by odm_xml::read through read_odm: documents outside the supported layout, values, namespaces, snapshot and metadata rules and XML 1.0, an option below its minimum, an archive name that holds no archive, and a source path that reaches no regular file (FILE-7). Each reports one issue, naming the source as given. Moved from odm_xml.rs, whose tests asserted each refusal's condition and a part of its message. A case compares the condition and the context keys that part states: a reason whole, from the refusal's message literal the part belongs to; the element, attribute, value, definition or option the message names; or nothing more where the part was the condition's fixed text.
